raw_text: `'use client'` marks React Client Components; needed for hooks, event handlers, browser APIs. `'use server'` marks Server Actions, passable to Client Components. `'use cache'` marks functions/components for caching (Next.js Cache Components); requires `cacheComponents: true` in `next.config.ts`. See `next-cache-components` skill for cache profiles, `cacheLife()`, `cacheTag()`, `updateTag()`. These are React directives, not Next.js-specific.
